import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.boxplot([
    not_readmitted["time_in_hospital"],
    readmitted["time_in_hospital"]])

plt.xticks([1, 2], ["Not Readmitted", "Readmitted"])
plt.ylabel("Days in Hospital")
plt.title("Hospital Stay vs Readmission")
plt.show()

avg_values = [
    not_readmitted["time_in_hospital"].mean(),
    readmitted["time_in_hospital"].mean()
]

labels = ["Not Readmitted", "Readmitted"]

plt.bar(labels, avg_values)
plt.ylabel("Average Days in Hospital")
plt.title("Average Hospital Stay by Readmission")
plt.show()

Patients who were readmitted tended to have longer hospital stays compared to those who were not readmitted. This suggests that longer hospital stays may be associated with a higher likelihood of readmission.
